description: This file defines the EventConsumerImpl class, which implements a message consumer for event messages in the Hono client project. It provides a static factory method to create instances that connect to a server, set up message receiving, and handle event consumption via Vert.x and Proton.

classes.name: EventConsumerImpl
classes.description: A class implementing a message consumer based on Vert.x and Proton for receiving event messages from a Hono server.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory method to create an EventConsumerImpl instance by establishing a receiver connection to the specified tenant and setting up event handling.
